The course provides the fundamentals and the operative techniques of wind engineering with special regard for wind energy utilizations and effects on structures.

全体の教育目標
Students will gain understanding the fundamentals and the operative techniques of wind engineering with special regard for wind energy utilizations and effects on structures.
個別の教育目標
This course offers state-of-the-art knowledge and information on various issues related to wind engineering, including some experimental techniques and computational tools for solving complicated and difficult problems. It also discusses basic matters such as atmospheric boundary layers, flow around bluff bodies. The importance of careful observation of phenomena, deep consideration and creation of mathematical models to reach understanding is demonstrated throughout the course.
授業計画
1. Introduction to wind engineering and wind energy.
2. Atmospheric boundary layer.
3. Aerodynamics: Bluff-body aerodynamics.
4. Wind tunnel experiments.
5. CFD
※The lesson plan may change depending on the progress of the class.
キーワード
Wind engineering, Atmospheric boundary layer, Aerodynamics: Bluff-body aerodynamics, Wind tunnel experiments, CFD
